_doc: The unlocks of the endings_1 pack. id, kind (starter_ship, species_start, blueprint, map_variant, skin), name, how (the hint shown on a locked entry) and payload (what the kind needs: starter_ship {ship, group, layout}, species_start {species, name?}, blueprint {recipe}, map_variant {variant}, skin {skin}). The 'unlock' effect of an event records one in the profile.

unlocks.name: Halcyon Tender
unlocks.how: Reach Halcyon: settle in the Haven, or lead others there.

unlocks.name: Ma's Kettle-class Tug
unlocks.how: Pay off Ma Gantry, then buy a berth at Gantry Rusthold (the Retire ending).

unlocks.name: Concord Frigate Resolve
unlocks.how: Restart the Concord Gate with the Authority's backing (the Way Out, Concord).

unlocks.name: Door Prize
unlocks.how: Restart the Scrapper Gate with the Clans' backing (the Way Out, Clans).

unlocks.name: Lumen Skiff Afterimage
unlocks.how: Open the Lumen Gate somewhere new with the Prism's backing (the Way Out, Lumen).

unlocks.name: Hollow-Touched: Welcome Aboard
unlocks.how: Learn what came out at the Snap, and stay to dinner (the Hollow ending).

unlocks.name: CS-002 Forbearance
unlocks.how: Board the Concord flagship CS-001 Patience (landmark).

unlocks.name: Halcyon Scout
unlocks.how: Meet the children of the skiff Fig and keep their secret (a Haven fragment).

unlocks.name: Halcyon Gardener
unlocks.how: Bring others to Halcyon (the Haven exodus).

unlocks.name: Basalt Gatewright
unlocks.how: Stand inside a Dead Gate's shell (landmark).

unlocks.name: The Quiet Lab's Siren
unlocks.how: Watch the Lumen's first gate study answer early (landmark).

unlocks.name: The Tide Comes Early
unlocks.how: Sit down at the Table in the Scrapper Gate (the Hollow ending).

unlocks.name: Lantern Lights
unlocks.how: Catch the first clean fragment of the Haven broadcast (landmark).

unlocks.name: Cold Lanterns
unlocks.how: Follow the wrong voice all the way to the Reach (the dark Haven ending).
